description: API hardening: fix input validation, auth gaps, dead code, and error response consistency in the HTTP API layer. Covers flaws 1, 3, 7, 12, 13. All changes are in src/api/index.ts and src/api/auth.ts. Independent of FEAT-002 and FEAT-003.
steps: Step 1 (Flaw 12 — dead TextEncoder): In src/api/auth.ts, remove the unused `const encoder = new TextEncoder();` on line 12. The file uses Buffer.from() instead; the import is dead code.

Step 2 (Flaw 7 — validate review body): In src/api/index.ts, the POST /review/:id handler already has a try-catch around req.json() and returns jsonError('invalid JSON'). This was already fixed in the current code. Verify it's present; no change needed.

Step 3 (Flaw 1 — validate decision field): In src/api/index.ts, the POST /review/:id handler already validates the decision field against ['attack', 'safe', 'dismiss'] and returns 400. This was already fixed in the current code. Verify it's present; no change needed.

Step 4 (Flaw 3 — protect POST /canary and DELETE /session/:id with auth): In src/api/index.ts, add `const _auth = requireAuth(req); if (_auth) return _auth;` as the first line of the POST /canary handler (line ~262, currently just `() => Response.json({ canary: generateCanary() })`). Change it from a sync arrow to an async handler that checks auth. Similarly, in the DELETE /session/:id handler (line ~279), add the same auth check as the first operation. The requireAuth import already exists at the top of the file.

Step 5 (Flaw 13 — consistent JSON error responses): In src/api/index.ts, find the fallback fetch handler at the bottom (line ~499) that returns `new Response('Not found', { status: 404 })`. Change it to return `jsonError('not found', 404)` to use the standard JSON error format. Also check the GET /session/:id 404 response (line ~276) — it already uses `Response.json({ error: ... })` which is consistent. Check GET /explain/:scanId 404 — also already consistent. Check POST /review/:id 404 and 409 — already consistent.
acceptance_criteria: The unused `encoder` variable is removed from src/api/auth.ts
POST /canary returns 401 when WARDEN_API_KEYS is set and no valid key is provided
DELETE /session/:id returns 401 when WARDEN_API_KEYS is set and no valid key is provided
The fallback 404 handler returns JSON {"error": "not found"} instead of plain text
All 328 existing tests pass with no regressions
POST /review/:id still validates decision as one of attack/safe/dismiss (already present — verify only)
verification: Run `bun test` and confirm all tests pass (328+ tests, 0 failures)
findings: All 5 acceptance criteria met. 331 tests pass (0 failures). POST /review/:id already validates decision field — no change needed. The jsonError helper was already imported and used elsewhere in the file.
